scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the hero section displays product branding, tagline, and CTAs correctly (REQ-1, REQ-2)

steps.description: Navigate to the MirDB product homepage
steps.context: User arrives at the homepage from external link or direct URL

steps.description: Check that the MirDB logo is prominently displayed in the hero section
steps.context: Logo should be clearly visible and properly sized

steps.description: Confirm the tagline 'A Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Protocol' is displayed
steps.context: Tagline communicates primary value proposition

steps.description: Check that 'Get Started' and 'View on GitHub' buttons are present and visible
steps.context: Primary and secondary CTAs should be easily identifiable

test_cases.input: Load homepage and inspect hero section
test_cases.expected: MirDB logo is displayed with proper dimensions and alt text
Tagline contains 'Persistent Key-Value Store' and 'Memcached Protocol'
Page scrolls to installation/quick-start section
Opens GitHub repository in new tab

scenarios.name: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify all key features are displayed with proper card layout (REQ-3)

steps.description: Scroll or navigate to the features section of the homepage
steps.context: Features section should be easily accessible from hero

steps.description: Check that all 5 key features are displayed as cards
steps.context: Features: Memcached Protocol, Persistent Storage, LSM Tree, Configurable Compaction, Async Networking

steps.description: Each card should have an icon, title, and description
steps.context: Card layout should be consistent across all features

test_cases.input: Count feature cards in features section
test_cases.expected: Exactly 5 feature cards are displayed
Card displays icon, title 'Memcached Protocol Compatibility', and description mentioning standard protocol support
Card displays icon, title referencing persistence/SSTables, and description of data durability
Card displays icon, title 'LSM Tree Architecture', and description of data structure benefits
Card displays icon, title mentioning compaction, and description of compaction strategy
Card displays icon, title mentioning Tokio/async, and description of networking capabilities
